common.freeNoAccount: Free without an account · AI requires an account

landing.heroTitle: Memorise German and Mandarin vocabulary, one chapter per session.
landing.heroSubtitle: German A1–C2 and traditional Mandarin from 當代中文課程. Pick a band or a book, then finish one topic or chapter per session — free, no account needed.
landing.coursesSubtitle: German uses bands, Mandarin uses books. Pick one to get started.
landing.courseDeMeta: {bands, number} bands · {cards, number} cards · {topics, number} topics
landing.courseZhMeta: {books, number} books · {cards, number} cards · {chapters, number} chapters
landing.featureSrsBody: One session finishes one topic or chapter. Repeated cards come back a few cards later, and a new cycle starts once every card has been shown.
landing.featureAudioBody: Audio from your device: de-DE for German and zh-TW for Mandarin.
landing.featureProgressBody: Progress per topic/chapter, activity per language, daily streak and a 90-day heatmap.
landing.featureMultiBody: German and Mandarin share the same engine, so a new language never touches the schema.
landing.footerNote: Topic cycles · UI: ID / EN · Languages: Deutsch · 華語

auth.name: Name
auth.resetBody: Enter your email and we will send you a reset link.
auth.checkEmail: Account created. Check your email to verify, then sign in.
auth.guestNote: Guest mode keeps progress in this browser only. Create an account for sync and AI features.

setup.title: Firebase is not configured
setup.body: Add the NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_* variables to .env.local (see .env.example) and restart the server. You can also use the emulator with NEXT_PUBLIC_USE_FIREBASE_EMULATORS=1.

dashboard.pickBandHint: Each band has topics ordered from the most general. Bands are never mixed in one session.
dashboard.pickBookHint: Each book has chapters in order. One session finishes one chapter.
dashboard.noRecentBody: Pick a band above to start studying.
dashboard.noRecentBodyBook: Pick a book above to start studying.
dashboard.noDecks: No decks yet. Create your first one.

decks.title: Decks
decks.subtitle: Manage decks and cards for every level.
decks.name: Deck name
decks.resetCycleBody: Restart this cycle? Progress marked as known in the current cycle is reset.
decks.emptyBody: Create your own deck, import a CSV, or generate cards with AI.
decks.deleteDeckBody: All cards in this deck are removed and cannot be restored.
decks.duplicateWarning: A card with the same front text already exists.

study.actionRepeatHint: The card comes back a few cards later
study.actionNextHint: Mark as understood in this cycle
study.cycleResetNotice: Every card has been shown. Cycle {cycle} starts now.
study.exitConfirm: This session is not finished. Leave now?

quiz.question: What does this word mean?
quiz.reverseQuestion: Pick the German word for this meaning
quiz.notEnoughCards: You need at least 4 cards in the deck for quiz mode.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.subtitle: Your learning progress so far.
stats.noData: No activity yet. Finish one session first.

levels.topicsHint: Study in order from the most general. One session finishes one topic.
levels.chaptersHint: Study in book order. One session finishes one chapter.
levels.resetBody: Restart this topic? Progress marked as known in the current cycle is reset.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Study preferences and account.
settings.learningHint: One session = one whole topic. A topic resets automatically once every card has been shown.
settings.shuffleCardsHint: When off, cards follow frequency order.
settings.ttsNoVoice: This browser has no German voice. Try Chrome or install extra voices in your OS.
settings.deleteAccountBody: All decks, cards and review history are permanently removed. Your login account stays active.
settings.guestBody: Your progress is stored in this browser. Sign in to sync across devices, back up to the cloud, and unlock AI.

import.title: Import CSV
import.body: Upload a CSV file (comma or tab separated). The first row must contain the column names.

ai.title: Generate cards with AI
ai.body: Describe a topic and the AI drafts cards for the selected level. Review before saving.
ai.topicPlaceholder: e.g. food in a restaurant, verbs of movement
ai.notConfigured: AI is not enabled. Set GEMINI_API_KEY on the server to turn it on.
ai.loginRequired: AI needs an account. Sign in or sign up first — every other study feature stays free without an account.
ai.error: Could not generate cards. Try again.

errors.weakPassword: Password must be at least 8 characters
errors.authPopup: Login popup was blocked. Try again or use email.
errors.authDomainBlocked: This app domain is not allowed to use Google sign-in. Add it in Firebase Console → Authentication → Settings → Authorized domains.
errors.authProviderDisabled: Google sign-in is not enabled. Turn it on in Firebase Console → Authentication → Sign-in method.
errors.authDifferentMethod: This email is already registered with another method. Sign in with email and password.
